readme.Notes: Later October dates, if present, are scheduled/forecast unless a source explicitly establishes the event happened.
Selection judgment: frontier-model program, open-weight distribution, and a major cloud parent. This is not a proven universal ranking; supporting model/product/backing data are in B tables.
Original source classifications are preserved where available. Analyst and press figures are not audited lab disclosures.
Unknown values must not be set to zero. Search-attempt metadata distinguishes executed queries from suggested or unrecoverable queries.
A mirrored record is not a new independent view; URL counts are not independence counts.
Do not strip qualifiers such as up to, annualized, announced, conditional, estimated, or simulated. Not every source can be normalized into a single scalar.
Leadership positions and survey forecasts are evidence about beliefs; evaluation rates and hardware measurements are conditional observations, not universal constants.

readme.Value: Historical state and public evidence date differ

readme.Notes: The package preserves original source-linked research. Automated format checks do not independently validate all source claims or make the dataset complete.

coverage.Biggest_remaining_gap: Definitions of AGI/transformative AI and forecast conditioning differ; complete contemporaneous platform distributions are not established for both endpoints.
No validated common scale for alignment difficulty; stated catastrophe probabilities are beliefs, not measured base rates.
Detection is conditional on model, attacker, task, monitor, budget, and protocol; external deployment failure probability remains unidentified.
No universal conversion from one decade of compute to capability; isolate algorithmic changes and benchmark saturation.
Many landmark and latest-model training FLOP are undisclosed or estimated; first observed capability is not a causal threshold.
Transfer to broadly non-verifiable domains is not established as a universal quantitative coefficient.
Developer, coding-agent, and research-task studies have different populations and outcome measures; frontier-lab realized end-to-end speedups remain incomplete.
Forecast assumptions and conditional takeoff definitions differ; not all model parameters have empirical calibration.
Effective FLOP/$ depends on precision, utilization, power, and pricing; Huawei throughput and shipment figures are not uniformly independently verified.
Private fleets, leasing commitments, utilization, and H100-equivalent conversions are incompletely disclosed; parent fleets are not lab allocations.
Announced, contracted, energized, and lab-allocated MW are distinct; site-level power mixes and allocations remain incomplete.
Private annualized revenue is often reported rather than audited; pending funding and parent-company revenue are not lab cash.
Latest training FLOP and exact allocation of pretraining versus post-training compute are often undisclosed.
Historical consumer/free-tier policy versions, routing behavior, and comparable active-user series remain incomplete.
Not all labs publish comparable framework versions; departure motives cannot be inferred without attributed statements.
Some lab/topic pairs lack two verified dated leadership statements, especially DeepSeek/Alibaba catastrophe estimates; silence is not a zero-risk belief.
Coverage ends 2026-10-13; subsequent October events cannot be treated as observed.
Not all organizations disclose detection logs or subsequent mitigations; conditional evaluations are not deployment incident rates.
Retrospective reports support stated reasons, not a unique causal explanation; not every proposed response is verified implemented.
Not every October 2026 implementation or legal status update is independently resolved.
Comparable official domestic AI-chip output volumes and direct evidence of leadership race beliefs are incomplete.
A matched dated probability distribution for a specified crisis, plus scenario-consistent chip-supply loss, is not established.
Verification proposals, political commitments, and operational enforcement are distinct; comprehensive implementation status is incomplete.
Comparable regional all-in construction cost per MW, with scope and dated build duration, is not fully established.
Regional load-interconnection waits are not interchangeable with generation queues; both endpoint snapshots are incomplete.
Delivered lab PPA prices and comparable all-in $/MWh are largely missing; announced reactor dates are not delivery evidence.
Comparable transaction prices, delivery lead times, and dated cloud GPU-hour quotes at both endpoints are incomplete.
Communication reduction is not wall-clock efficiency; measured penalties for frontier-scale training across commercial sites remain incomplete.
Historical equivalent-capability price declines are not a constant future rate; a fully matched January 2025–October 2026 series is incomplete.
Consistent consumer/API/coding revenue splits are not disclosed for every lab; total revenue does not identify the split.
